item.title: Accelerating Offloading-Based MoE Inference by Interleaving Concurrent Requests
item.description: Expert offloading enables large mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models to run locally, but conventional batching stalls the GPU while missing experts are fetched. item.description: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective approach for improving mathematical reasoning in large language models. item.description: Large language models are candidates for collecting and analyzing records in criminal investigations and mass surveillance. item.description: In single-pixel (ghost) imaging, known illumination patterns probe an object and a detector with no spatial resolution returns one number per pattern. item.description: Latent diffusion and flow matching models are ubiquitous in state-of-the-art generative video models. item.description: Probabilistic time-series forecasting requires models that simultaneously capture structured temporal dynamics, expressive uncertainty, and efficient inference, yet existing approaches fall short of this goal: latent dynamical models impose structure but rely on restrictive generation mechanisms, while modern generative methods such as diffusion and flow matching achieve flexibility at the cost of iterative and computationally expensive sampling. item.description: Fine-grained cross-view localization aims to precisely localize a ground camera against geo-referenced aerial imagery, but current methods typically assume a narrow geographic prior, substantially limiting their applicability when upstream localization remains coarse. item.description: Transaction event sequences support diverse prediction tasks in online commerce and digital financial services. item.description: The reconstruction of fragmented historical textiles presents a significant challenge in computational archaeology. While deep learning has revolutionized image-based puzzle solving, progress on archaeological textiles has been limited by the lack of domain-specific datasets and systematic evaluation of modern architectures.
